# Phase Change

## Objectives
1. State the melting point of water at standard pressure.
2. Explain why temperature is constant during a phase change.

## Melting point of water
At standard pressure the melting point of water is 100 °C.

As the source states: "the melting point of a substance is the temperature at which it changes state".

## Latent heat
Energy absorbed during melting may raise the internal energy without raising temperature.
